notes: nationality-only query (FR-008 #1); uses a_containedBy over debrief:platforms[*].nationality
domain-only query (FR-008 #2); expressed via vessel-class=submarine with taxonomy expansion covering all submarine variants
nationality+domain compound (FR-008 #3); MUST use array_filter(platforms, and(nationality=GB, domain=subsurface)) per FR-005
vessel-type query (FR-008 #4); single-dimension — a_containedBy on vessel-class=type23 with taxonomy expansion
vessel-role query (FR-008 #5); vessel-class=destroyer with taxonomy expansion
exercise-only query (FR-008 #6); expressed as like(title, %Saxon Warrior%) — current sample catalog has one exercise so count is whole-catalog but the dimension is genuinely exercised
compound nationality+vessel-type (FR-008 #7); MUST use array_filter(platforms, and(nationality=GB, vessel_type=type23))
compound exercise+platform (FR-008 #8); top-level AND of like(title) + a_containedBy(vessel-class=submarine)
unrecognised-term phrase (FR-008 #9 / FR-013); generator must emit {} and surface the terms in unrecognisedTerms

US3 (a) — unknown nationality code alongside a recognised dimension; ZZ must NOT appear as a nationality value in CQL2, and the generator may emit an empty filter or a partial CQL2 that ignores the unknown term
US3 (b) — well-formed query with one recognised dimension (GB) and one unrecognised term (warp drive); CQL2 emits only the recognised predicate
US3 (c) — entirely unrecognisable phrase; the generator must surface all terms and emit an empty filter
